scheme_name: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SC Category)
other_conditions: The beneficiary must own a minimum of five (5) animals.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to 75% of the purchase cost of a power‑driven chaff cutter, or ₹18,000 whichever is lower, is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
